messages.author: Sayan Poddar
messages.body:
Dear AMBER developers and Users,
I was trying to install amber20 but have run into this error while running
*./run_cmake* command.
*CMake Error at cmake/PythonBuildConfig.cmake:129 (message):*
*  Failed to determine relative PYTHONPATH: python command failed with
error  Traceback (most recent call last):    File "<string>", line 1, in
<module>  KeyError: 'unix_prefix'Call Stack (most recent call first):
CMakeLists.txt:122 (include)-- Configuring incomplete, errors occurred!See
also
"/home/sayan/software/amber/amber20_src/build/CMakeFiles/CMakeOutput.log".*
So how to overcome this?
Thank you
-- 
*with regards*
*Sayan Poddar*
*PhD Research Scholar*
*Department of Biosciences and Biomedical Engineering*
*Indian Institute of Technology Indore*
*India*

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sun, Mar 24, 2024, Sayan Poddar via AMBER wrote:
>
>*  Failed to determine relative PYTHONPATH:
Did you make any changes to run_cmake?  What is the result of typing
'echo $PYTHONPATH'?  What OS version are you using?
....dac

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sun, Mar 24, 2024, Sayan Poddar wrote:
>No, I haven't made any changes to run_cmake file.
>
>My OS version is *Ubuntu 22.04.4 LTS*
>
>*echo $PYTHONPATH *is not showing anything. I have attached a snippet of my
>screen below it.
Please don't send emails to me: use the mailing list!
What does "cmake --version" report?  How did you install cmake?
Maybe someone else will recognize this error.  There was a somewhat similar report here: http://archive.ambermd.org/202305/0003.html.
It's possible that upgrading to AmberTools23 will solve the problem.  I have a very vague recollection of this, but nothing very clear.
...dac
